_resolved.question: When is the Nova Farms Attleboro dispensary open?
_resolved.was: Claimed 'Sunday through Wednesday until 8 PM, Thursday/Friday/Saturday until 11 PM' - contradicted locations.html, the live novafarms.com hero, and the Store openingHoursSpecification.
_resolved.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-09-16. Operator supplied the Google Business Profile listing, which shows 8 AM-11 PM for ALL SEVEN days (Wed/Thu/Fri/Sat/Sun/Mon/Tue). GBP is authoritative for real store hours. The Store schema (Mo-Su 08:00-23:00) was already correct; the stale FAQ PROSE was corrected on-page to match, then included in the schema. No exclusion needed.

exclusions.questionStartsWith: How much cannabis can I buy at a Massachusetts dispensary
exclusions.reason: States 'up to two ounces of marijuana flower', which contradicts Nova Farms' OWN Attleboro page ('up to 1 ounce (28 g) of flower per visit'). Both describe the same Massachusetts limit, so one is wrong. Could not be authoritatively verified this session (mass.gov returned 403, masscannabiscontrol.com 404, web-search budget exhausted). A regulated purchase-limit claim is not something to publish as a rich result on an unverified basis.
